scope: W4 factual integration for all Kandarin, Karamja, and Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary tasks. It preserves research provenance and exact package-level task facts while referencing existing systems rather than duplicating mechanics. It does not create task or claim actions, graph edges, account observations, strategy scores, or a route.

facts_included: all 130 package tasks with exact requirements, item fate, boostability, and completion boundaries
sourced fixed tier rewards and lamp details
references to existing canonical facts and actions
strategy_excluded: RNG, crop, daily, charge, or collection-log assumptions
